definitions.ceiling: 1 - share of positions whose true depth is outside the training classes
definitions.qualified_verdict: yes -> 'yes, above input baseline' iff MLP(activations) - MLP(input baseline) bootstrap lower bound > 0 for all three probe seeds, else 'yes, not above input baseline'; no -> 'structurally capped' if ceiling < bar; no -> 'no (ceiling within x of bar)' if 0 <= ceiling - bar < 0.01
